feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 October 2026 4:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 14 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure near Iceland, cold front affecting the area overnight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 in places this evening and overnight, veering west or northwest 3 to 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain arriving from the northwest early tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in places, veering northwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, imminently clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first.
